verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single first-party marketing line saying Zia Agent Studio 'also works via CLI' alongside Cursor, VS Code and Claude Code. It does not name an official Zoho CRM CLI, its commands, or installation, and the phrasing may refer to third-party agent tools via MCP rather than a Zoho-built CLI. missing for 10: a named official CLI tool, CLI documentation (install, auth, commands), coverage of CRM operations from the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Build custom agents in Zia Agent Studio. Also works via CLI with Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, and more.
